assay: bulk RNA-seq (50-bp SE, HiSeq 2500) of FACS-sorted Nestin-EGFP+ NS/PCs; forebrain at E15, dentate gyrus at P5 and 12w
primary_estimand: Effect of 8 wk voluntary wheel running on the adult (12w) dentate-gyrus NS/PC transcriptome of prenatally VPA-exposed mice: VPA+RW vs VPA (S1.4.p2, Fig. 5). Exercise was only given to VPA mice; there is no Ctrl+RW arm, so the exercise effect is identifiable only within VPA-exposed animals.
planned_contrasts: VPA+RW vs VPA at 12w (S1.4.p2, Fig. 5B-E; exercise estimand; paper reports no DEG count, only that running mostly amended VPA-distorted genes incl. Cxcr4)
VPA vs Ctrl at 12w (S1.2.p1, Fig. 2B/3; defines the VPA-DEG set that running normalizes; 12w count not stated in text, hundreds per S2.p2)
VPA+RW vs Ctrl at 12w (implicit normalization check in Fig. 5B box plots)
inclusion: Exercise estimand uses the 9 12w DG samples (3 Ctrl, 3 VPA, 3 VPA+Run); E15 and P5 samples are VPA-only developmental comparisons without exercise and were analysed per stage in the paper (S1.2.p1).
paper_results: E15 VPA vs Ctrl: 248 DEGs (235 up). 12w VPA vs Ctrl: Cxcr4 and Cntn2 down (Fig. 3D-E). Running normalizes VPA-DEGs incl. Cxcr4 (Fig. 5).
